data.title: 贞德[Alter] · 新宿雨夜·霓虹街角与傲娇侧影
data.description: 【贞德[Alter] · 新宿雨夜·霓虹街角与傲娇侧影】被淅沥冷雨浇湿的新宿街头，闪烁的霓虹灯倒映在积水之中。换上帅气黑色皮夹克与短裙的黑贞单手插兜倚靠在墙角，金色眼眸斜睨着你，别扭地轻哼一声——「别自作多情了！我只是顺路经过这里而已……喂，你那把伞太小了，还不快点靠过来一点！」
data.promptProse: At the wet Shinjuku street corner, Jeanne Alter leans against the wall with one hand in her jacket pocket and the other relaxed beside her skirt. A black leather jacket and tank top pair with a short black pleated skirt, dark tights and boots for the rainy outing. She turns her head toward the viewer with a reluctant, slightly embarrassed look as rain gathers along the wall. Cyan and magenta shop reflections cross the pavement, leaving her silver hair and golden eyes distinct. Frame the wall-supported posture and skirt clearly, without readable signs.
data.action: 穿黑夹克短裙靠在街角墙边，一手插兜，侧头望向同行者
